name: Enum Filter Driver (SA)
help: Enumerates security-related filter drivers (AV, activity monitors, content screeners)
long_help: Scans the registry for minifilter drivers and identifies security-related filter drivers based on their altitude values. Reports activity monitors (360000-389999), antivirus products (320000-329999), and content screeners (260000-269999). Useful for identifying endpoint protection software.

arguments.name: system
arguments.desc: Remote computer to query (default: local machine)
